_comment: Testimonials and films made with FilmMakerStudio, for start.html's #voices section. EMPTY ON PURPOSE: nothing here may be invented — not a quote, not a person, not a film. To add one: (1) get the person's written consent to publish their words, name, role and (if any) film title, and keep that consent on file with the date; (2) add an object below — { id, quote, name, role, film?, consentOn } for a testimonial, { id, title, year?, director?, format?, consentOn } for a film — quoting them verbatim; (3) copy it into start.html's #voices section by hand in the markup of the commented example there, and remove `hidden` from the section and from the list you used; (4) run `npm run test:testimonials`, which fails if the markup and this file disagree in either direction. Withdrawn consent means removing the entry from BOTH places in the same commit. Shape: {testimonials: [...], films: [...]}; src/pages/start.js reads this file and draws any entry the markup lacks, then un-hides #voices.
